quarterly_data.quarter: Fortune Precision results briefing Q&A: 2025 annual and Q1 2026 (05-14-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Chairman Zheng Guangwen (results briefing): Q1 2026 revenue was a quarterly record of RMB 10.43 hundred million, up 36.84% year on year, and net profit excluding non-recurring items RMB 3,796.63 ten-thousand, up 233.51%, a return to profit for the quarter; he said capacity at the Shenyang, Nantong and Beijing bases ramped smoothly and began to deliver scale benefits, and with higher efficiency and lower expense ratios gross profit rose too.
quarterly_data.figure: Q1 2026 revenue RMB 10.43 hundred million (+36.84%); recurring net profit RMB 3,796.63 ten-thousand (+233.51%)

quarterly_data.quarter: Fortune Precision results briefing Q&A: 2025 annual and Q1 2026 (05-14-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Technology and gas systems (results briefing): chairman Zheng Guangwen said 2025 brought three key technical breakthroughs - overcoming a machining bottleneck for CMP polishing pads, an in-house supercritical cleaning chamber with micron-level precision, and gold-plating capability with reflectivity at the top domestic level - plus 73 new patents (395 IP items in total). He said the investment in international brand Compart deepens technology cooperation and speeds localisation and domestic share gains in gas delivery systems, combining Compart's 35 years of patents and global supply chain with Fortune's; the company plans a brand matrix with Compart for standard parts, a gas brand for integrators and the Fortune brand for metal parts.
